children: Scotts Miracle-Gro redeemed all $250.0 million of its 5.250% Senior Notes due 2026 on Sep 11, 2026, at par plus accrued interest, pursuant to the indenture terms. Following the redemption, the notes are no longer outstanding, interest ceased to accrue, and holders retain only the right to receive the redemption price. The action effectively terminates obligations under the applicable indenture and simplifies the company’s capital structure.
: Retire debt and reduce interest expense
